sources.snippet: Abliterated BF16 weights from Blackfrost-Research (599 GB, 120 shards), derived from zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash. iMatrix measured from the model's own activations on a disk-built calibration proxy (the source exceeds the in-memory calibration limit).

sources.title: GLM-5.3 - openlm.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. With 320B total parameters and just 18B active parameters, it outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the price, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.

sources.snippet: OrcaRouter abliterated GLM-5.3-Flash directly in block-FP8 — no LoRA, no jailbreak. How weight-level refusal removal actually differs, mechanically.

sources.title: dealignai/GLM-5.3-Flash-ABLITERATED-FP8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is GLM-5.3-Flash in FP8 with its refusal behavior — which caused heavy over-refusal, especially on copyright and other benign-but-flagged requests — removed directly in the model weights. FP8 runs at native speed on Hopper (H100/H200) GPUs. Genuine weight modification — none of the usual shortcuts:
